reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with the terrain in Provincia. Our new native sparse CA allows for more efficient water depth management, ensuring that your ponds and ditches behave realistically without freezing your frame rate. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: New Water Mechanics Update in Provincia!
steam.body: We're excited to share that our latest update enhances how water interacts with terrain in Provincia. With the new native sparse CA, water depth is now managed more efficiently, allowing for realistic pond and ditch behavior without frame rate drops. Read more about the changes and improvements here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
